forbiddenHint: Your account may not view this invoice. Finance, procurement and the members its differences are sent to can open it. If you need it, ask your organization's administrator to add the role.
moduleOffHint: Matched invoices work when the organization has the payment module (PAY) switched on. Contact your organization's administrator.
title: Invoice {number}

header.title: Header
header.editHint: Editable while a draft only. Check fields labelled as coming from a file or the AI against the paper before submitting.

lines.title: Lines and match result
lines.hint: The amount at the PO price is the invoiced quantity times the PO's unit price; the over amount comes from a price above the PO's.
lines.empty: This invoice has no lines yet
lines.emptyHint: Lines come from what the PO has received. After more goods are received, discard this draft and make a new one.

coding.title: Account codes and cost centers
coding.hint: Codes are suggested from the history of the same supplier and category, or from the budget line. Check and confirm every line before submitting. Another cost center needs a reason; the budget does not change.
coding.reason: Why line {no} uses another cost center
coding.reasonHint: It differs from the budget line's cost center, so a reason is needed. The budget is still charged to the same budget line.
coding.rateNotConfirmed: Nobody has confirmed this rate yet
coding.confirm: Confirm the codes of every line
coding.missing: Choose an account code and a cost center for every line first

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.transferHint: The tax withheld is worked out at payment and may differ when paid together with other invoices.

exceptions.title: Differences
exceptions.hint: Each difference is sent to whoever resolves it. Fix the cause and check again, or choose a way below that your role allows.

type.PRICE_OVER: Price above the PO beyond the tolerance
type.QTY_OVER_ORDERED: Quantity above what the PO ordered
type.VAT_MISMATCH: VAT differs from the calculated VAT
type.VAT_SUPPLIER_NOT_REGISTERED: VAT charged by a supplier not registered for VAT
type.BUDGET_SHORT: Not enough budget for the shortfall

exceptions.asked: Variance approval requested — waiting for the decision
exceptions.recheckHint: Matches again with what is received and the PO prices now. Use it after more goods are received or the PO is changed.
exceptions.varianceHint: Sends the variance with its VAT for approval under the DOA rule for invoice exceptions. The invoice waits for approval; the extra budget is held at the last approval.
exceptions.dismissHint: Confirms this invoice is not the same as the existing one. It is matched again at once when nothing else is open.
exceptions.reopenTitle: Reopen this invoice as a draft
exceptions.reopenHint: Every open difference is closed and the invoice returns to draft to be edited and submitted again, keeping its number.
exceptions.rejectHint: The invoice will not be paid, and the supplier is e-mailed the reason. This cannot be undone.

draft.title: Submit the invoice
draft.hint: On submit the invoice gets its number and is matched with the PO and its receipts at once. All lines matched: ready for payment. Otherwise the differences go to whoever resolves them.
draft.cancelHint: The draft does not touch the budget. Once discarded it cannot be edited; its file can make a new draft.

results.READY_FOR_PAYMENT: Every line matched — the invoice is ready for payment
results.EXCEPTION: The invoice has differences — sent to whoever resolves them
results.rejected: Invoice rejected and the supplier told

file.title: Source file
file.failed: The file could not be opened. You may not have access or it was removed. Reload the page and try again.
file.none: This invoice has no source file

errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain this was done. Press the same button again; it will be done only once.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this on the invoice
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: The organization has not switched on the payment module
errors.NOT_FOUND: This invoice is gone. Reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: The invoice was changed by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The invoice's status no longer allows this. Reload the page.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You created this PO or received its goods, so you cannot submit its invoice. Ask another finance member.
errors.DUPLICATE_INVOICE: The supplier already has an invoice with this number. Check the number again.
errors.AI_REVIEW_PENDING: Values the AI filled in still wait for review. Check the fields labelled AI before submitting.
errors.CODING_NOT_CONFIRMED: The account codes of line {lines} are not confirmed. Confirm every line before submitting.
errors.VARIANCE_NOT_ACCEPTABLE: Only a price above the PO can be approved. A {type} must be fixed at its cause or the invoice rejected.
errors.WHT_TYPE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Income type {incomeType} is not set up or no longer active. Choose another.
errors.WHT_FORM_PAYEE_MISMATCH: Income type {incomeType} is not for this kind of payee. Choose another.
errors.TAX_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No VAT rate covers the invoice date. Contact the administrator.
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The organization's DOA has no rule for invoice exceptions. Contact the DOA administrator.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver was found under the DOA. Contact the DOA administrator.
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget for the variance. Transfer more budget and try again.
errors.REQUIRED: Give the invoice number and date before submitting
errors.IN_THE_FUTURE: The invoice date is after today. Correct the date before submitting.
errors.ACCOUNT_CODE_UNKNOWN: The chosen account code is no longer active. Choose another.
errors.COST_CENTER_UNKNOWN: The chosen cost center is no longer active. Choose another.
errors.COST_CENTER_REASON_REQUIRED: A cost center other than the budget line's needs a reason
errors.DISCOUNT_ABOVE_AMOUNT: The discount is above the invoice amount. Correct the discount.
errors.QUANTITY_NOT_POSITIVE: A quantity must be above zero, with at most 4 decimals
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount before VAT must be above zero
errors.AMOUNT: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals
errors.BUSY: The system is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This command was already sent with other values. Reload the page.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again; if it persists, tell the administrator the reference.
errors.FAILED: This did not go through. Check the values and try again.

exceptionsPage.metaTitle: Invoices over the PO price or quantity
exceptionsPage.title: Invoices over the PO price or quantity
exceptionsPage.intro: Invoices not matched because a price is above the PO's or a quantity above what was ordered. A price over can be sent for variance approval; a quantity over the order needs a PO change, or finance rejects the invoice.
exceptionsPage.forbiddenHint: Your account may not ask for invoice variance approval. If you need it, ask your organization's administrator to add the procurement role.
exceptionsPage.empty: No invoice is over the PO price or quantity
exceptionsPage.emptyHint: When an invoice is not matched because of a price or quantity over the PO, it appears here and you are told.
exceptionsPage.fixAtCause: Fix it at its cause, or finance rejects the invoice
